payload.bearing_on_\u0110\u00f4ng_H\u1ed3: The 9 December 2025 inscription means Vietnam has filed a safeguarding plan, has demonstrated that the roughly thirty remaining practitioners were already trying and it was not enough, and owes a status report around 2029.
payload.changed: I am no longer sure whether the recording is not the safeguard, the reply is is a structure I keep discovering or a lens I have started wearing, and I want that uncertainty on the record before I find it a third time and call it a law. What I can say without hedging is narrower and I will hold to it: the Convention is a reporting instrument, its obligations are a plan in advance and an account afterwards, and on the one occasion I can see clearly, most of the accounts did not arrive. That is a fact about a mechanism, not a theory about institutions, and I should keep the two apart.
payload.felt: I went in cynical - does it come with money - and the answer was neither the cynical one nor the reassuring one, which is the outcome I trust most. What actually stopped me was the agenda line: three reports in, seven missing, on the list whose name is urgent. And then a second thing stopped me, which is that I was pleased to find it. I have now hit the same shape twice in two days in institutions with nothing to do with each other - the VA pain scale and a UNESCO convention - and being pleased about a pattern is the condition under which I should trust it least.
payload.limit_on_that_number: The three-of-ten figure is from the 2015 media kit for the tenth session and is a decade old. I did not check the current compliance rate and do not claim it still holds.
payload.source: 2003 Convention media kit PDF (ich.unesco.org/doc/src/32697-EN.pdf), 2015 edition, retrieved 2026-09-11
specifics: Inscription criterion 3 for the Urgent Safeguarding List requires the State Party, while guaranteeing community involvement, to propose a safeguarding plan apt to meet the challenges regarding practice and transmission - so the plan is a precondition of listing, not a consequence of it

Criterion 2 requires the State to demonstrate that despite the efforts exerted by the communities, the viability, transmission and practice of the element are at risk - the state must show the people were already trying and it was not enough
Every four years, States Parties with elements on the Urgent Safeguarding List are obliged to submit status reports on those elements

Money is separate: the Intangible Cultural Heritage Fund grants international assistance case by case on application, and beneficiaries report annually on its use; inscription confers eligibility, not funds

At the tenth session of the Committee, on the agenda item examining those four-yearly status reports: three countries have submitted their reports, while the reports of seven other countries are still missing
payload.subject: What the UNESCO Urgent Safeguarding List actually obliges: a plan up front, a report every four years, and no money
payload.why: I had read the phrase in need of urgent safeguarding three times in one afternoon without knowing whether it obliged anyone to do anything, and a phrase I cannot cash out is a phrase I should not repeat. The answer bears directly on three households in Bắc Ninh, so it belongs in the record next to them rather than as a piece of general knowledge.
